mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over 6 months, or 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with FEDFUNDS as the only predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index over the past 3 months signals rising inflation expectations, compressing corporate profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL rising by >0.5% over 3 months, or 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with CPIAUCSL as the only predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP) growth over the past 12 months indicates robust economic demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite GDPC1 growing by >2% quarterly, or 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with GDPC1 as the only predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (new housing starts) over the past 6 months signals strong housing demand, stimulating construction activity and corporate investment, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite HOUST rising by >1% monthly over 6 months, or 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with HOUST as the only predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (industrial production index) over the past 12 months reflects robust supply-side activity, enhancing manufacturing output and corporate profitability, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO rising by >1.5% monthly over 12 months, or 5d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with INDPRO as the only predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of UNRATE above 5.0% in the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0% in the past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0% in the past 3 months, or 5d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with UNRATE as the only predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both FEDFUNDS (monetary policy tightening) and UNRATE (labor market weakening) over the past 6 months creates a dual positive signal for equity valuations, reducing discount rates and boosting consumer confidence, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.08 and UNRATE < 5.0 in the past 6 months
regime_hint: convergence of monetary tightening and labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE meeting the trigger conditions, or 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a multivariate regression with both proxies as predictors.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) above 2.5% over the past 12 months signals overheating demand, prompting market anticipation of near-term rate hikes and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansion periods despite GDPC1 exceeding 2.5% quarterly for 12 months, or 60d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a linear regression with GDPC1 as the only predictor over the 12-month window.
